title: Jalapeño Cheddar Cottage Cheese Protein Bagels
originalTitle: Jalapeño Cheddar Cottage Cheese Protein Bagels
ingredients: 1 cup full-fat or 2% cottage cheese (blended smooth)
1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
1/2 medium jalapeño, thinly sliced into rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Blend the cottage cheese in a blender or food processor until completely smooth, then mix in a bowl with 1 cup flour, 2 tsp baking powder, and half of the shredded cheddar until a soft dough ball forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces, roll each into a rope, and join the ends to shape 4 bagels on the parchment sheet.
Brush the tops with beaten egg wash, sprinkle with Everything Bagel seasoning, remaining shredded cheddar, and sliced jalapeño rings. Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes until puffed and golden brown.
